about.p1: Hey, I'm Mihail. I'm a Sofia-based director who also edits videos. I'm currently in my final year studying Cinema and Television at New Bulgarian University.
about.p2: I love the entire post-production puzzle, especially color grading and cutting in DaVinci Resolve. Over the past couple of years, my work has bounced between directing short documentaries and TV reality shows, to editing fast-paced digital content and broadcast deliveries.

jobs.desc: Sole video specialist owning the full pipeline — cinematography, lighting, sound, edit and DaVinci grade — delivering high-volume content for 7Arts, ArtPortal and Art Label productions.

detail.title: 7Arts
detail.synopsis: Independently managing the video pipeline, handling shooting, lighting, sound, and editing. I produced a high volume of trailers, social reels, and promos across their streaming platform, news division, and theatre productions.
detail.description:
Although initially brought on as an editor, I operated as the company's sole video production specialist, managing the entire pipeline from set to final export. I independently handled all cinematography, lighting, and sound recording, followed by cutting and color grading in DaVinci Resolve. I delivered a high volume of content tailored to three distinct branches of the company:

7Arts (Streaming Platform): Shot and edited promotional trailers for the platform itself, alongside dedicated trailers and social marketing reels for individual films and shows.

ArtPortal: Handled the end-to-end production of a massive catalog of short-form reels for the arts and news website, successfully translating written articles into engaging, fast-paced video content.

Art Label Productions & The Big Praz Show: Filmed and crafted dynamic announcement videos for upcoming theatre productions and edited high-energy promotional advertisements for The Big Praz Show.

jobs.desc: Two internships — Production Intern in 2022 and Video Editing Intern in 2025, cutting Deroni recipe videos and Уча, зная и играя episodes.

detail.title: Timeless Production Group Ltd
detail.synopsis: Two internships — from Production Intern in 2022 to Video Editing Intern in 2025, cutting Deroni recipe videos and Уча, зная и играя.
detail.description:
Video Editing Intern — February 2025 – April 2025

Returning to the company for a second internship, I stepped directly into an active editing role. During this three-month period, I was trusted to cut commercial YouTube content for clients, specifically focusing on fast-paced, short-form recipe videos featuring Deroni products. Additionally, I took on broadcast responsibilities by editing several episodes of the children's educational television program Уча, зная и играя.

Production Intern — July 2022 – September 2022

During my initial time with the company, I focused on absorbing as much as possible about how a professional production environment operates. I assisted the team with general, day-to-day tasks, doing the foundational, hands-on work required to keep a production moving while learning the industry ropes from the ground up.
